items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 9:1
items.html: At the time that the concluding Malchut ascended to the place of the Chazeh of the Partzuf TNHY of AK, and the coupling Malchut ascended to the place of the openings of the eyes, still before the coupling was made in the openings of the eyes of SAG of AK, then the lights of ZON, which were in the vessels of the head, separated in this and went out of the inner vessels and became Makifim to the lights of Chaya and Yechida. And these Makifim went out and surrounded around the central point of the first restriction — that is, below the conclusion of the feet of AK — for the point of the conclusion of the second restriction had not yet been fixed, since the coupling upon the screen of the openings of the eyes had not yet come out. For the point of the conclusion is fixed only by the power of the coupling upon the screen, which strikes the light and pushes it backward, and by this makes the border and the conclusion. Therefore these Makifim, which departed from the ZON of the head before the coupling of the openings of the eyes, went out and encircled around the point of the conclusion of the first restriction.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 9:2
items.html: And besides the aforementioned Makif, which was in a vessel and departed from it because of the ascent of Malchut to the place of Bina, as above, afterward — after the coupling had already been made upon the screen in the openings of the eyes — then the lights of Chaya and Yechida were compelled to remain outside, because of the lack of vessels of the ZON that went out of the inner vessels of the head. Therefore they went out and surrounded around the ten Sefirot of Nekudim in the aspect of Makifim of Chaya and Yechida. And these surrounding lights are the essence of the Makifim of Chaya and Yechida of Nekudim, because they went out by the power of the coupling of striking upon the screen, and they already have the new central point of the second restriction, made by the power of the new screen in the openings of the eyes. Therefore they surround around the center of the second restriction, which is the aspect of the point of the conclusion of the world of Atzilut, and not around the central point of the first restriction, like the aforementioned previous Makifim, which encircled around the feet of AK. Moreover, the new Makifim that came out of the aspect of the coupling drew to themselves also the previous Makifim, which had encircled below the conclusion of the feet of AK, and they too surrounded around the center of the second restriction that was made.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 9:3
items.html: And it was explained that there were two kinds of Makifim here, of the line [Yosher] and of the circles: the first is the lights of Yechida and Chaya that were in the vessels of the head and departed from there because of the ascent of Malchut to the place of Bina; and of them the Rav says that they surround around the conclusion of the feet of AK. And the second Makifim are those that came out by the coupling upon the screen — the screen that ascended to the place of Bina did not let them enter the head — and of them the Rav says that they encircled around the NHY of AK, that is, around the ten Sefirot of Nekudim that clothe the NHY of AK, namely, around the center of the second restriction, as is explained. (Items 3 and 6).
